detached_structure.evidence: A separate gray-roofed garage-like building sits behind the main house at the end of the driveway, to the north of the house.

signals.notes: The central lot has a gray-shingled house with a long driveway running to a rear detached garage. The front lawn is dry and patchy, and there is a large tree on the right side. A blue pool is visible at the top of the tile on a neighboring lot, not the central one.
